title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 210 ]

blocks.text: Books can take us out of ourselves. None of us has had enough personal experience to know other people - or, indeed, himself -thoroughly. We all fell lonely in this vast, irresponsive world. We are shocked by the injustice of the world and the hardships of life. But from books we learn that others-greater men than we - have suffered and have sought as we have.

readingSentences.english: Books can take us out of ourselves.
readingSentences.korean: 책은 우리를 우리 자신 밖으로 데려다줄 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: None of us has had enough personal experience to know other people - or, indeed, himself -thoroughly.
readingSentences.korean: 우리 중 누구도 다른 사람, 혹은 참으로 자기 자신조차도 철저하게 알 만큼 충분한 개인적 경험을 갖지 못했다.

readingSentences.english: We all fell lonely in this vast, irresponsive world.
readingSentences.korean: 우리 모두는 이 거대하고 무반응한 세상에서 외로움을 느낀다.

readingSentences.english: We are shocked by the injustice of the world and the hardships of life.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 세상의 불의와 삶의 고난에 충격을 받는다.

readingSentences.english: But from books we learn that others-greater men than we - have suffered and have sought as we have.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 책을 통해 우리는 다른 사람들, 즉 우리보다 더 위대한 사람들도 우리처럼 고통받고 갈구해 왔다는 것을 배운다.
